name: BoxingGirl's MOBIUS
original_name: ボクシングガールズ・メビウス
source:
The stage is the women's boxing association "MOBIUS".
You are the coach of a female boxer who belongs to MOBIUS.
Win through rivals and become the champion!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ238042/?locale=en_US]DLsite[/url]]
